correctness.rationale: Exact Kalman maps give a factored rational commutator with nonnegative numerator precisely for all positive covariance when g+lambda*q>=1. Enumerating the four Bernoulli receipt cases yields a scalar adjacent-interchange identity for arbitrary increasing losses. Independent random increasing suffixes preserve first-order stochastic order; bubble-sorting proves all-horizon optimality. In the contractive-noisy regime the commutator is a quadratic with exactly one positive zero and hence a sharp ordering reversal. 14884 exact-rational checks replayed successfully from package.

source_inspections.title: Universal optimality of uniform observation precision in scalar Kalman filtering

value.rationale: The theorem gives a universal finite-horizon, all-increasing-loss optimum of a naturally fixed nonadaptive sensor-reliability permutation problem, replacing factorial schedule enumeration with sorting. A single dimensionless condition couples state contraction and process innovation and is proven sharp by a unique prior-variance crossover, not an arbitrary numerical example. It distinguishes reliable-last versus reliable-first sensing and is meaningful to communications-constrained Kalman design despite its scalar and common-precision limitations.
